fields.description: What this card is allocated against — a company Asset (the normal case), or an Employee (a private vehicle on a company fuel/toll scheme, which has no Asset record at all). Determines what Allocated To below links to.
fields.label: Allocation Type

fields.description: The vehicle (or, for a private-vehicle allocation, the Employee) this card is issued against. A card being replaced or reissued is a wholly new Fleet Card record for the same Allocated To, never an edit to this one (same convention as Vehicle Licence).
fields.label: Allocated To

fields.description: The vehicle's registration plate — the company Asset's own, or the employee's private vehicle's own.
fields.label: Registration Number

fields.description: Who this specific card was physically issued to.
fields.label: Issued To

fields.description: Whether the card has actually been physically collected by Issued To yet.
fields.label: Collected

fields.description: The card's PIN. Stored as plain text at the user's explicit request — be aware this is visible to anyone with read access to Fleet Card (list view, reports, exports), the same exposure the original spreadsheet already had.
fields.label: Card Pin

fields.description: Captured directly from the card/statement — unlike Vehicle Licence's 12-month statutory disc cycle, a fleet card's validity period varies by issuing bank and isn't derived from Issue Date.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: Active/Expiring/Expired are refreshed daily (see engineering.controllers.fleet_card.refresh_all_statuses, hooks.py's daily scheduler bucket) and set immediately on submit/reissue/cancel — stored, not virtual, so it can be filtered and reported on from the list view.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Days remaining until expiry, as of today. Computed live, never stored.
fields.label: Days Left

fields.description: The signed "Fleet Card Issued" print-out, scanned back in — required before this card can be submitted.
fields.label: Attach Documents

fields.description: Set automatically by the Reissue button — the card this one replaces for the same Allocated To. That previous card is marked Superseded the moment this one is submitted.
fields.label: Previous Fleet Card

fields.description: Why this card is being (re)issued — lost, damaged, stolen, driver change, initial issue, etc. Required whenever Previous Fleet Card is set.
fields.label: Reason
